name: kromacommerce
description: Enterprise-grade microservice e-commerce platform with price intelligence engine

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/common && npm run build --workspace=packages/database
scripts.build:services: npm run build --workspace=apps/auth-service && npm run build --workspace=apps/catalog-service && npm run build --workspace=apps/order-service && npm run build --workspace=apps/scraper-service
scripts.build:backend: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:gateway
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k --kill-others --teardown "npm run clean:ports" -n "gateway,auth,catalog,order,scraper,web" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:scraper" "npm run dev:web"
